en.text: I seek refuge in that Goddess Sri, who shines like the radiant moon, blazing with glory, revered by the gods in all worlds, most magnanimous, who holds a lotus. May my misfortune (Alakshmi) be destroyed! I surrender unto You.

en.text: O Goddess radiant as the sun! Out of Your intense spiritual austerity was born the king of trees, the holy Bilva tree. May the fruits of that tree, through spiritual merit, dispel inner ignorance and outer poverty.
